summary: I concluded that the terminal FeCl3 group of the oxo-bridged [Cl3Fe–O–FeCl3] anion has rotational disorder, and I submitted a model that includes it. In the original model, the strongest difference peaks (about 0.9–1.5 e/Å³) sat 0.7–0.9 Å from Cl1, Cl2 and Cl3. Each of these peaks was about 2.2–2.4
